I've finished the review and written the report to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/02/spawned/mastermind-v1-2-scroll-fix/review.md`. The verdict is **fix**.

- **No requirements:** the task folder has no `requirements.md`, and the owner's ask in `session.jsonl` is cut off at "Chat v". I couldn't check whether the owner's ask was met.
- **Stale Recite readme:** `audio/Recite/readme.md` still says the ▶/⏸ and ↺10 controls sit under every reply bubble. The diff now hides them until the bubble is tapped or playing.
- **Mixed jobs:** the diff combines the Chat V1.2 scroll fix with a separate Recite control-visibility change, and nothing in the folder says the owner asked for the second.
- **V1.2 readme:** it doesn't mention the new log-height rule.
- **Notes:** a second click listener could be folded into the existing one, `Recite/ai/log.jsonl` is untracked, and there are no screenshots, so the heights at 400 and 1920 are unverified.

I made no code edits.

I wrote `review.md` in the task folder with verdict **fix**. I couldn't check whether the owner's ask was met, because the task folder has no `requirements.md`.

- **Missing requirements:** `session.jsonl` line 1 cuts the owner's voice ask off at "Chat v".
- **Wrong or mixed diff:** `review/diff.patch` is about removing the 🧠 mark from ChatV3 replies. It contains nothing about the V1.2 scroll fix.
- **Not landed:** that ChatV3 change is not in the main tree; `ChatV3.js` still draws the 🧠.
- **V2 impact:** V2 extends ChatV3, and its readme and test still treat the 🧠 as V2's own mark. Neither was updated.
- **Open stale docs:** two findings from the earlier review (`review.jsonl`) are still unfixed. `audio/Recite/readme.md` still says the controls are under every reply, and `ext/Chat/v1-2/readme.md` says nothing about the log-height rule.
- **Notes:** there are no screenshots or `layout.json`, so the sessions-page height is unverified. `ReciteBubble.js` adds a second click listener that could be folded into the existing one.

I made no code edits.

I rewrote the outcome for `mastermind-v1-2-scroll-fix` as a ticked checklist and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. I did not open the page or take a screenshot. This pass only covered the task's files and the text check.

- **Ticked items:** the three deliveries (Chat V1.2 scroll, Recite control on the tapped bubble only, V3 brain avatar removed) are now ticked with their proof and linked.
- **Unproven ask:** the owner's voice ask was cut off at "Chat v" and no `requirements.md` exists, so I left an open `- [ ]` saying the ticks can't be checked against the owner's words.
- **Not fixed:** the text check also flagged `review.md` as 300 words with no picture and one 62-word paragraph. It is the reviewer's file for agents, so I left it.

I wrote the rewrite straight into `session.jsonl` because the task's agent has already landed.
